set.body: The v0.24.10 change review found a P0 in retention (archived items ping-pong back into done.jsonl), a merge gate that trusts commit statuses from any actor, and seven releases without regenerated design docs. Issues #412 and #413 add duplicate ticket creation on fresh clones and a request for CI-owned sync with Azure Pipelines support. This epic fixes all of it in one PR per workstream: retention, marker probe, gate hardening, PAT identity for bot PRs, CI sync, release gate, and an Azure template.
set.title: Fix the v0.24.10 review findings and close #412 and #413

set.body: Copy the plan to the scratchpad, run grok, codex, and a Fable 5.1 subagent as reviewers, let one Fable 5.1 editor subagent apply the worthy edits once, then capture the plan with plan-capture. The plan is not edited after capture.
set.title: Council review, single edit pass, and plan capture

set.body: done_state folds done and archive together, refreshed ids are pruned from the archive, and archive appends dedupe by item with the newest snapshot winning. Without this the archive ping-pongs forever and done.jsonl never shrinks. Must land before 2026-10-17.
set.title: Retention: stop re-snapshotting archived items into done.jsonl

set.body: The FIFO cap currently counts archived items and evicts real ones once the archive exceeds the cap.
set.title: Cap counts only items present in done.jsonl and unparseable ts never occupies a cap slot

set.body: A parent is never archived while a child remains in done or todo, and an already archived child does not hold its parent back. The roadmap and status reports keep the epic column.
set.title: Parent veto in eviction, live children only

set.body: A garbage line in archive.jsonl must not crash the nightly job, even when no item is open. Negative, float, and nested config values print a warning instead of vanishing.
set.title: Tolerate a corrupt archive line and warn on ignored retention config values

set.body: Merge-check folds the archive so an archived owner still blocks a duplicate link, with the archive path inferred so callers do not change. An untracked archive.jsonl counts as dirty.
set.title: Archive-aware duplicate ownership check and untracked-archive guard

set.body: Add the eight test classes listed in the plan, add test_retention and test_watermark to the explicit CI list, and fix the step order in the compact.py header, the spec, the CLI reference, and the README.
set.title: Retention tests and doc renumbering

set.body: observe_remote already fetches every remote ticket. Keep the marker to key map, populate it before the owned pass, pick the dedupe survivor when markers collide, and make it the third source of remembered_key so a clone without link events updates the existing ticket and records the link. Closes #412.
set.title: #412: consult the remote marker map before creating a ticket

set.body: A transient listing failure on a fresh clone is the #412 scenario. Skip creates for that run and say why.
set.title: Probe guard when the listing fails and the clone has no push memory

set.body: Print which key source answered for one item without mutating anything, forward the flag through cmd_sync, report probe hits in a new relinked count, and suggest dedupe --dry-run when the sync created tickets.
set.title: sync --explain and report hints

set.body: A fresh clone must not see output that claims it has push memory.
set.title: adapter check says when the clone has no push memory

set.body: Read-only permissions in worklog.yml, remove the dead bypass actor from the ruleset and apply the ruleset live with gh api, and write ADR-0011 that supersedes ADR-0010 with the PR-landing path and the PAT decision.
set.title: Interim merge-gate hardening and ADR-0011

set.body: Open and merge compact and post-merge PRs with a maintainer's fine-grained PAT so pull_request CI runs natively, then delete the status bridge, actions: write, statuses: write, and the workflow_run trigger. Requires the secret before merge.
set.title: Bot PRs use the WORKLOG_BOT_PAT identity

set.body: Each bot job closes the previous open bot PR before regenerating from main, so a stale PR never blocks under the strict checks policy. post-merge skips its own PRs by branch prefix.
set.title: Pipeline hygiene: supersede open bot PRs, delete-branch, explicit loop guard

set.body: A real drift finding must reach the PR comment. A repo with no adapter gets no noise comment.
set.title: sync --report drift is never masked and the local-only comment is suppressed

set.body: post-merge sets the adapter env, runs a push-only sync with the bot token before rendering, stages the log with the docs, and caches sync-state. Manual push sync refuses without --force in a CI-owned repo and session-doctor warns. Optional dedupe --check PR gate behind ticketing.ci_dedupe_check.
set.title: #413: CI as the authoritative syncer behind ticketing.sync_owner: ci

set.body: A release fails when a live doc's git_hash does not descend from the previous tag or the freeze record for that tag is missing. The release skill spawns the design-docs agent explicitly and checks that it finished.
set.title: Release gate for design-doc freshness in doc-verify --strict

set.body: The wiki still describes published.json. Run design-docs in release mode and write the freeze note in the same PR as the gate.
set.title: Regenerate the live design docs for v0.24.10

set.body: init.sh writes azure-pipelines.yml with the same hook-only steps as the installed GitHub workflow when the origin remote is Azure DevOps. A contract test keeps the two heredocs in step. NDQR verifies live.
set.title: #413: Azure Pipelines template from init.sh

set.body: A user guide section that explains the template, the mapping, and how to wire another forge by hand.
set.title: CI wiring docs and the GitHub Actions to Azure Pipelines mapping table
